title: Outlined AI
oneLiner: AI-powered mobile app for extracting and summarizing audio/video content
impactMetric: AI transcription + summaries in one flow

problem.heading: Problem
problem.description: Extracting insights from audio and video content is time-consuming, with no simple way to get summaries, notes, or key questions.

myRole.heading: Role
myRole.description: Led end-to-end development of the mobile app, building core features and integrating AI workflows for transcription and summarization.

solution.heading: Solution
solution.description: Built a mobile app that converts audio/video into transcripts, summaries, notes, and key questions using AI-powered processing pipelines.

impact.heading: Impact
impact.description: Enabled users to quickly turn raw media into structured insights, combining multiple AI capabilities into a seamless experience.
